method: PDF hyperlink extraction + global oEmbed title/structural matching (no downloads)

kft_pdf_youtube.label: KFT official (2026 Directory PDF → youtu.be)
kft_pdf_youtube.notes: Canonical links from Krishnamurti Foundation Trust Full-Length Directory 2026. Primary choice for full-length audio/video.

archive_org.label: Internet Archive
archive_org.notes: Variable format/bitrate; useful when no KFT link exists. Search is fuzzy.

comparison_guidance.audio_vs_video: PDF link + oEmbed title prefix (Audio| / Video|) indicates stream type; video usually higher resolution but larger.
comparison_guidance.alternates: When multiple URLs exist per code, compare media_format and match_score in links-comparison.csv
